system.effect:
This Interface's effect: Gain Equipment Projection and choose its profile during Recovery or Downtime. Once per turn, after rolling at least 3 dice for an Action using this Implement, reroll up to two dice showing 3 or lower if you have not moved since the start of your most recent Turn.

Equipment Projection (EC02)

ACTION • Roll 2+ • USES — • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Profile vs Profile

Range / Targeting: 6 units / Single creature

Effect: Use the profile recorded on the Interface. Physical: Grace vs Fortitude; deal 1 Force Damage on a hit. Mental: Acuity vs Composure; deal 1 Psychic Damage on a hit. Spiritual: Adaptability vs Harmony; deal 1 Radiant Damage on a hit. This is an ordinary Source attack, not a Function Augment.

Surge 1: After resolving the attack, move 1 unit. Once per use; does not require a hit.

Surge 2: Deal +1 Damage to the hit target. Once per use.

Design note: Channeling Interface increases Range to 8. Profiles are a catalog convention, not a universal relation between Damage type and Defense.
system.special: Any movement breaks the condition. Uses the one-reroll-per-die convention.
